title: Northern Rivers Commercial Property Return to Business Support Grant – Terms and Conditions
summary: This page outlines the terms and conditions for the Northern Rivers Commercial Property Return to Business Support Grant.
who_can_apply: The commercial space must have been subject to a lawfully executed and binding commercial lease agreement with a tenant (Small or Medium Business) at the time of or within 6 months prior to the 2022 Floods.

The commercial space must have been subject to a commercial lease agreement with a tenant (Small or Medium Business) at the time of or within 6 months prior to the 2022 Floods, even without a formal commercial lease agreement.
The commercial space must have been subject to advanced stage negotiations to be leased to a Small or Medium Business at the time of the 2022 Floods.
The commercial space must have been advertised as available for commercial leasing at the time of or within 6 months prior to the 2022 Floods.
The commercial space must have been undergoing renovations to enable leasing to a Small or Medium Business at the time of or within 6 months prior to the 2022 Floods.
The commercial space must have been used by the applicant to operate a Small or Medium Business at the time of or within 6 months prior to the 2022 Floods.

The common property or shared facilities must have been used (or intended to be used) in connection with operating a Small or Medium Business at the time of or within 6 months prior to the 2022 Floods.
The applicant must be commencing or recommencing a commercial lease at the commercial property.
what_you_need: A document listing the direct storm and flood-related damage for which the application is made.
Photographic evidence of all direct and flood-related damage.
If the amount claimed is greater than $25,000, the applicant must provide a document listing the direct storm and flood-related damage.
If the applicant is a Returning Customer, they must provide further photographic evidence of damage.
Tax invoices, official receipts, bank statements, or other similar records to verify that amounts paid under Previous Grants were used according to the intention of those grants.
Any other evidence to verify any fact, matter, or thing.

faqs.a: The grant provides support for commercial properties affected by the 2022 Floods.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for the grant?
faqs.a: Eligibility depends on the commercial space's status before or around the 2022 Floods, such as being leased, advertised, or used by a Small or Medium Business.

faqs.q: What evidence do I need to apply?
faqs.a: Applicants must provide documentation of damage, photographic evidence, and records to verify payments and amounts claimed.
